title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Principal Sql Server Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Principal Sql Server Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken) Please upload your CV Resume in English.Monthly salary:$5,500 - $7,000 USDAlong with our partner, we're looking for a Principal Database Engineer who can serve as the technical leader for our SQL Server–focused engineering team. This person should be the team's strongest expert in SQL Server development, performance engineering, and operational reliability — and equally strong in designing data‐centric solutions that balance correctness, performance, maintainability, and business constraints.The ideal candidate brings deep, hands‐on mastery of SQL Server internals and can connect engine behavior to real‐world workload patterns. They should be able to diagnose, design, enhance, and optimize database solutions at scale, and guide others in doing the same.You will collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are well‐understood, technically feasible, and aligned with long‐term architectural goals.Essential Duties: Database Design and Development:Guide the evolution and improvement of database architecture, design and implementations. Apply expert‐level understanding of relational modeling, T‐SQL, indexing strategies, and SQL Server engine behavior to build systems that scale and perform under real‐world workloads. Performance Monitoring and Optimization:Continuously assess system performance at both the instance and query level. Diagnose and remediate issues, including those involving poor execution plans, parameter sniffing, bad cardinality estimation, SARGability obstacles, inadequate or incorrect indexing, and concurrency issues involving locking, blocking, and/or deadlocks. Engineering Solution Design:Break down complex data and workload problems, identify multiple viable solution paths, and evaluate them against functional and non‐functional requirements. Clearly articulate tradeoffs, recommend, and justify the best approach. Collaboration with Development Teams:Partner closely with application and service teams to ensure database designs support application behavior, performance goals, and operational constraints. Provide guidance on query patterns, schema usage, and integration with .NET and cloud services. Incident Management:Lead the response to database‐related incidents. Perform root‐cause analysis, implement durable fixes, and improve observability, alerting, and operational readiness. Mentorship and Training:Coach and mentor database engineers and developers. Establish and promote best practices in SQL development, performance tuning, and operational excellence. Data Security Management:Contribute to the implementation and enforcement of security controls, ensuring protection of sensitive data and compliance with relevant standards. Backup, Recovery, and Reliability Engineering:Contribute to the design and management of resilient backup, restore, and disaster‐recovery processes. Help ensure systems are prepared for failure scenarios and can recover predictably.Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Experience: 10+ years in database engineering, data management, or database administration, with significant hands‐on experience in SQL Server. Technical Skills: Deep expertise in SQL Server development, performance tuning, and engine internals. Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, statistics, concurrency, and workload behavior. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including managed SQL services and related data technologies. Proficiency in T‐SQL;  familiarity with C#/.NET services is a plus.Key Competencies: Database Design and Architecture:Ability to design scalable, efficient SQL Server solutions in cloud environments, with strong judgment around schema design, indexing, and workload patterns. Performance Tuning and Optimization:Expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance issues at all layers of the SQL Server stack. Cloud Technologies:Experience with cloud‐based database services (Azure SQL, Managed Instance, AWS RDS, etc.) and understanding of how cloud infrastructure impacts database design and performance. Programming and Engineering Skills:Strong T‐SQL development skills and familiarity with the broader SQL Server ecosystem. Ability to reason about system‐level design and integrate database solutions with application architectures. Data Management and Security:Ensure data integrity, enforce security controls, and resolve data‐related issues with precision and accountability. Leadership and Collaboration:Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and communicate clearly with cross‐functional partners. Influence architectural direction and foster a culture of engineering excellence.Benefits: A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to lead and optimize large-scale data systems that power critical business operations. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Desenvolvedor De Software Sênior - Protheus
description:
Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor De Software Sênior - Protheus em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções robustas, garantindo a performance, escalabilidade e integridade do ERP, além de atuar como referência técnica para o time.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Desenvolver, sustentar e otimizar rotinas complexas utilizando ADVPL e TLPP. Arquitetar, implementar e sustentar integrações via APIs REST e Web Services para comunicação com sistemas externos, processos automáticos complexos JOBS e SCHEDULES. Garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de Code Review e aplicação de padrões de projeto (MVC, Orientação a Objetos). Colaborar estrategicamente com as áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades funcionais (Financeiro, Fiscal, Faturamento, etc.) em soluções técnicas eficientes. Promover a mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores Plenos e Juniores, disseminando boas práticas e novos conhecimentos. Participar ativamente de cerimônias em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Linguagens : Domínio avançado em ADVPL e TLPP (Ênfase em classes e REST). Arquitetura: Experiência sólida em Orientação a Objetos e integrações REST/SOAP. Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread) Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning). Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps). Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados.Requisitos desejáveis: Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front-end com PO-UI (Angular). Experiência com Protheus em ambiente Cloud. Conhecimento funcional avançado nos módulos principais (SIGAEST, SIGAPCP, SIGAFIS, SIGAFAT, SIGAFIN, SIGAGPE entre outros). Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD aplicadas ao Protheus.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;  ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;  ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;  ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;  ● Plano de saúde e odontológico;  ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;  ● Vale transporte;● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;  ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário;  ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida;  ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada;  ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;  ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Java Developer With Kotlin - Relocation To Portugal
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Java Developer With Kotlin - Relocation To Portugal em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.What are we looking for? Proven 4+ years of experience as a Backend Developer with Java and Kotlin. Solid understanding of backend architecture, APIs, and service-oriented/microservices environments. Ability to collaborate effectively with frontend and backend teams in a full product context. Experience with modern development practices (version control, code reviews, CI/CD) is a plus. Knowledge of SQL and/or relational databases is a plus. English proficiency at B2 level (interviews can be conducted in English). Available for relocation: from Brazil to Portugal (mandatory). Available for remote or hybrid roles based in Lisbon and/or Porto.What do we have to offer you? Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;  Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;  Aubay Training Academy,designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;  Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;  Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;  Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;  We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;  Language platform, withconversation classes in 12 languages;  Working model: remote or hybrid based in Lisbon or Porto.What makes us different? Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;  We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;  We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;  We promote closeness and an informal environment;  Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.Your next adventure starts here! If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:. The future is waiting for you — and so are we!Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;  Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL's headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, no46 em Lisboa or use the DPO's e-mail -. The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Gerente De Projetos Sap

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Esta oportunidade será para atuação em um dos maiores grupos industriais do Brasil, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, governança e excelência operacional. Os profissionais atuarão em projetos corporativos SAP de alta relevância para o negócio, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com forte exposição a iniciativas de transformação.O que esperar do seu title: Especialista De Produtos De Dados (Cientista De Dados)

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Produtos de Dados (Cientista de Dados) para fazer parte do nosso time em São Paulo-SP!Responsabilidades e atribuições- Avaliar projetos complexos de data science em diferentes áreas de negócio; - Planejar e executar Provas de Conceitos de soluções de ciência de dados; - Propor a utilização demodelos referência de mercado para resolução de problemas de negócio; - Construir modelos preditivos utilizando técnicas de diversas áreas da ciência de dados, como modelagem supervisionada e não-supervisionada, visão computacional e NLP;
